annotations.title: Find a Place or Group Code

description: Turns a place or demographic name or code into the code the data uses (district_code, school_code, county_fips, or demographic) with its label, e.g. 'Atlanta Public Schools' or 'Fulton'. A guessed code otherwise returns an empty page. `kind` is district, school, county, or demographic; 'Fulton' as a county is the county and as a district is the school district, which are different things. Matches loosely, ranks candidates, and flags `ambiguous` when several are close. A real Georgia place is never matched to a different one: a consolidated city returns its county ('Columbus' -> Muscogee, matched_on=consolidated_city), another city asked as a county returns the county it is in, flagged ambiguous, and a one-letter misspelling returns matched_on=typo. A city school system answers to the common forms of its name ('Decatur Public Schools' -> City Schools Of Decatur, matched_on=city_system), and a county's system to its place name ('Cobb Schools' -> the county's district, matched_on=county_system). `place_note`, when present, explains the match and is worth passing on to the user. Census tracts have no kind here: filter by tract_geoid, the 11-digit Census tract ID.
